tool_input.content:
version: 2
models:
  - name: fct_portfolio_return
    description: "Portfolio return fact. One row per account per month with portfolio returns, benchmark comparison, and excess returns. Grain: account_number x as_of_date."
    config:
      domain: 'Return'
    columns:
      - name: return_key
        description: "Surrogate key (account_number + as_of_date)"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: account_number
        description: "Account FK"
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: as_of_date
        description: "Return period end date"
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: mtd_return
        description: "Month-to-date return"
      - name: ytd_return
        description: "Year-to-date return"
      - name: one_year_return
        description: "Trailing 1-year return"
      - name: benchmark_name
        description: "Comparison benchmark"
      - name: mtd_excess_return
        description: "MTD alpha vs benchmark"
      - name: ytd_excess_return
        description: "YTD alpha vs benchmark"

  - name: fct_account_value
    description: "Account value fact. Current snapshot per financial account with market value, model allocation, latest returns, and holdings summary. Grain: one row per financial account."
    config:
      domain: 'Account'
    columns:
      - name: account_value_key
        description: "Surrogate key"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: financial_account_id
        description: "Account FK"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: market_value
        description: "Current total market value"
      - name: holding_count
        description: "Number of distinct holdings"
      - name: holdings_market_value
        description: "Sum of position market values"
      - name: total_unrealized_gain_loss
        description: "Sum of unrealized gain/loss"
      - name: mtd_return
        description: "Latest month-to-date return"
      - name: ytd_return
        description: "Latest year-to-date return"
